title: MOBIX LABS, INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-09
summary: Mobix Labs, Inc. filed a Form 8-K announcing a 1-for-10 reverse stock split effective April 6, 2026 at 4:00 p.m. Eastern Time. The reverse split applies uniformly to all outstanding shares of Class A and Class B Common Stock, with cash paid in lieu of fractional shares. The company's trading symbol remains MOBX on the Nasdaq Capital Market.
